say:2:1423462001:1.source_cn: 因度厄，义捐进行的还顺利吗？

say:3:1423462002:1.text: It's going swimmingly thanks to you! Once Celestine arrived, even the stubborn nobles started showing up. We've raised a good amount already.
say:3:1423462002:1.source_cn: 多亏你们，莱索兰来了之后，一些态度顽固的贵族也听到风声...

say:4:1423462003:1.text: A few nobles are still sitting on the fence, though... Could you bring them over? I'd like a word with them.
say:4:1423462003:1.source_cn: 不过还是有几位贵族在远处观望……可以麻烦你把他们请上来...
